en.title: P-A-N-N
en.phrase: Pallava Administrative Nodes: Periyar, Ayakar, Nadu, Nagarattar
en.decryption: Use this to recall the hierarchy from smallest unit (Nagarattar/village) to the provincial level (Mandalam).

fact.en: Mistaking 'Nadu' as a purely Pallava term; it existed across most Tamil dynasties.
fact.hi: Mistaking 'Nadu' as a purely Pallava term; it existed across most Tamil dynasties.

fact.en: Assuming the administrative hierarchy was identical; Chalukyas had more centralized control compared to the Pallavas' decentralized Brahmadeya-led system.
fact.hi: Assuming the administrative hierarchy was identical; Chalukyas had more centralized control compared to the Pallavas' decentralized Brahmadeya-led system.

fact.en: Confusion between 'Vatapi' (Chalukya capital) and 'Kanchi' (Pallava capital) regarding administrative oversight.
fact.hi: Confusion between 'Vatapi' (Chalukya capital) and 'Kanchi' (Pallava capital) regarding administrative oversight.
